speaker: Ms He Ting Ru
text: asked the Minister for Digital Development and Information (a) whether any research has been done on whether there is a gender gap in the adoption rates of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in Singapore, particularly in generative AI; (b) whether any groups have been identified as being more reluctant in adopting such AI technologies; and (c) whether there will be targeted initiatives to encourage these groups to better adopt AI technologies in educational and workplace settings.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: This reflects the broader trend of under-representation of women across the technology sector.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: Women in Singapore are doing well compared to the global average.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: This demonstrates their openness to participating in the technology industry and embracing new technologies, like AI.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: We aim to encourage AI adoption across all groups, while providing tailored initiatives to meet the needs and varying competencies of specific groups.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: These allow individuals to acquire new AI skills, enhance their productivity and improve their employability in a rapidly evolving job market.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: These modules allow students to explore and tinker with technology, including through the design of prototypes incorporating AI.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: NLB also provides free access to learning resources, like LinkedIn Learning, which contain short courses on AI and GenAI for all NLB members.

speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
text: By ensuring broad access to AI tools and offering tailored support for different skill levels, we aim to make AI adoption inclusive and accessible to all.

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: I just wanted to ask some supplementary questions on this.

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: First is, whether or not, in the Code for Fun, have there been any attention paid to certain groups which might be found to be generally more reluctant or a little bit more afraid to engage with the topics?

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: And also, some of the schemes that she mentioned earlier, such as the NLB schemes, whether or not these schemes have user data or participant data tracked, not just in terms of gender, but age group and also socioeconomic background?

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: The thinking behind this is just to find out whether or not we need to target these groups that are generally under-represented in technology and AI.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: I appreciate the Member's question and concern in identifying certain groups which may not be as receptive or a bit more exposed to AI.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: She made specific references to two of the programmes that we are working on.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The Code for Fun programme is something that we do in schools.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: That is something that the teachers roll out and we do, indeed, aim to encourage more students to participate in it.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We definitely can always look at enhancing this and ensuring that students from all backgrounds get to benefit from this.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Being in school allows for that accessibility to students from different backgrounds to have access and for teachers to identify those who, perhaps, need more support and more nudging.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: The NLB programme, indeed, is also with the same thinking.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: But it is something that we are cognisant of, that there are certain groups that may not be as receptive or maybe even groups we want to reach out to share these resources and we will continue with our efforts to do so.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: We continue to work also with partners through our Digital for Life programmes.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Through these partners, who are working in the ground communities, they help us access different groups with different modalities.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: With the suite of all these efforts, we should be able to reach out to different groups.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: But if there are any groups that the Member has identified that needs further support, please let us know and we would be happy to reach out and extend some of these resources to them.
